issues.description: The parameter ordering for the create_controlled_single_qubit_gate function is inconsistent between the template and the solution. In the template the signature is create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits, target, control, gate_matrix) while the solution uses create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits, control, target, gate_matrix). This mismatch (target and control swapped) creates confusion about which integer argument denotes the control qubit and which denotes the target qubit and can lead students to implement or call the function incorrectly.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a consistent parameter order across template and solution. Prefer the conventional ordering (num_qubits, control, target, gate_matrix) and update the template signature to def create_controlled_single_qubit_gate(num_qubits: int, control: int, target: int, gate_matrix: NDArray[np.complex128]) -> DD (or, alternatively, update the solution to match the template). Also update any documentation/comments to explicitly describe the parameter order to avoid ambiguity.
